characterization_methods: Time of Flight–Secondary Ion Mass Spectroscopy (ToF-SIMS)
evidence: The growth temperature dependence of structure, electronic density, and impurity levels for the prepared NiO films was studied using X-ray reflectivity, X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, time of flight–secondary ion mass spectroscopy (ToF-SIMS), and transmission electron microscopy. ... XRR was also employed to determine electronic density and surface roughness of the deposited layers. ... XRD was employed to investigate the dependence of film crystallinity on Tg. ... FTIR spectroscopy was used to determine the chemical composition, structure, and corresponding variations with Tg, of the layers. ... Depth profiles were determined by ToF-SIMS. ... TEM analysis and ESI elemental mapping of films grown using Ni/EtCp/O3 at Tg = 150 and 300°C were performed.
